name: omkoi-station
description: Omkoi Station queue and service management (CPE 334 Theme 9). Root scripts delegate to server/ and client/.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server ci && npm --prefix client ci && npm --prefix e2e ci
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.test:all: npm run test:server && npm run test:client && npm run e2e
